svg.title: Storage Platform Architecture and Scope of Responsibility
svg.desc: Object, file, block, and KV services use a core software platform with a persistent storage pool and a distributed memory pool. Shared principles include compute–storage disaggregation, data–control plane separation, and hardware–software co-design. The hardware platform includes NICs, SSD controllers, NPU/CPU, DRAM, NAND (TLC/QLC), HDD (HAMR/SMR), and tape. A red dashed boundary marks the scope of responsibility: platform software and hardware and media co-design; upper-layer services are outside this boundary.
